items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: And Louis Premon was over there every night.

ctx.x: I'll tell you a nice guy to meet, or see him in the business, Charlie Barnett. Yeah. Do you know, I was talking to Captain Hattie, have you heard that tape? And he told about the jam sessions where Ross Barnett would come and play Stockton's song? Yeah. Yeah. Not Ross Barnett. Yeah. That was the governor of Mississippi. I know, yeah. But he got Charlie Barnett and Ross Barnett. Yeah, he was mixed up, yeah.

Well Charlie Barnett and he used to come over there by the entertainers when he was in town. And Louis Premon was over there every night. I used to sing Chinatown in China, my version of China. And every night I'd have a different version and Louis was over there trying to pick up on it. You understand me?

I think you recorded Chinatown. Who? Louis. I'll have to dig up. No, I'm talking about Louis Premon. He might have. I'm not sure, but I'll begin. He might have. Well anyway, who was in Alvin Wall's band? Is that Fats Wall? Is that the guy they call Fats?
